method: Inspected original source art, producer masks/contact sheets, and independently extracted half-second crop sequences plus final/first full-scene pairs with view_image. Independently decoded every video frame and recomputed mean adjacent-frame difference, seam difference and seam ratio. SHA-256 checked before and after decode and again before report write.
limitations: No real-time motion playback or ambience audition performed.
Approval is limited to the exact visual assets below, not integrated product or production readiness.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA frame sampling and full-decode technical QA only
findings: Original composition, sleeping cat, desk objects, window frame, tree trunk and roof edges remain aligned in sampled frames.
Rain/light changes are very subdued and remain in the garden. No obvious drifting mask boundary or room spill appears in first/middle/last or half-second samples.
Mug steam and leaf movement are too subtle to judge convincingly from sampled frames; this is an intentionally quiet effect, not evidence of full environmental motion.

Independent full decode confirms the repaired 3.3837x seam ratio passes the existing less-than-4 gate; absolute full-frame seam difference is 0.2023 on a 0–255 channel scale. This is a narrower margin than Alpine and should still receive repeated playback review.
followUps: Check repeated full-speed playback for a faint garden reset every 3.5 seconds.
Audition integrated forest/rain ambience and verify it feels consistent with an open garden window.

scenes.scope: Exact-SHA frame sampling and full-decode technical QA only
findings: Window arches, furniture, stairs, balcony, floor reflections and camera remain aligned across sampled frames.
Hearth flame shapes vary subtly and remain inside the opening; sampled frames do not show smoke crossing the stone frame.
The shark silhouette is deliberately preserved by the revised mask and shows no sampled shape distortion. Underwater window light changes are very subdued.
Independent full decode confirms a 2.5545x seam ratio and small absolute seam difference of 0.1088, passing the existing technical gate.
The prominent waterfall on the right and shark remain frozen, limiting the requested sense that everything feels real. This is a product-quality opportunity, not a newly introduced geometry defect.
followUps: Review candle/light/fire motion in repeated full-speed playback; samples cannot establish natural timing.
Consider adding localized downward waterfall motion in a later polish pass while keeping stonework fixed.
Audition integrated quiet water/fire ambience; sound should not imply a rushing waterfall if the visual remains static.
